So I don't think the banks necessarily did anything incorrect here, but that is the nature of you putting cash on a bank's balance sheet. And obviously, they didn't possess an awful lot of that. And again, there was a lot of speculations in different assets and a lot of co-mingling with other institutions that absolutely could not have happened without being illegal in the traditional finance sector. Whether that was in bad faith or just pure ignorance and naivety, I wouldn't want to be the judge over that.
